messages:
Alyssa Chen: Heads up 1 DataCity LLM Summit prep thread. Panel submission done but lightning slot still open. Need owners for speaker, swag counts, shipping, and lead routing. Who can own what? :spiral_calendar:

Mike Patel: I got shipping + on-site setup. Need final SKU counts and official booth footprint. Also vendor lead times?

Sylvia Nguyen: Creative can RUSH art to vendor by Tue. Proposed swag: stickers (2200), embroidered patches (550), portable chargers (140), crewnecks (48), recycled totes (200). Will mock backdrop with benchmark curve.

Jordan Ruiz: I'll take speaker submissions + lead flow. Suggest QR -> Typeform -> Segment -> SFDC Lead queue "Events/Leads" w/ AE rotation. Minimal fields: name, email, company, role, interest checkbox, opt-in. Typeform feels mobile-friendly.

Priya Kaur: Growth to run attendee breakfast + post-conference webinar. Need utm params on form for nurture stitching.

Ram Singh: I'll handle AV, power, and lead scanner. Venue COI due by 2026-06-01. Freight elevator dims? max crate 46\" x 34\"?

Alyssa Chen: Vendor lead time 6 business days. Sylvia  cut PO when counts final. Mike escalate freight if rush required.

Sylvia Nguyen: Final counts: stickers 2200, patches 550, chargers 140, crewnecks 48 (S9 M18 L15 XL6), totes 200. Uploading tonight.

Sylvia Nguyen: Upload (mock): https://drive.redwood.app/marketing/datacity-2026-art. Files: `backdrop_final.pdf`, `sticker_layout.ai`, `patch_vector.svg`, `crewneck_front.psd`, `tote_print.ai`.

Mike Patel: Shipping plan draft:
```
Ship-to: Redwood Events / Mike Patel
Attn: Mike Patel
Venue: DataCity Conference Center, Hall B, Booth B12
Ship window: 2026-06-09 to 2026-06-11
Carrier: compare FedEx vs local LTL
Special: freight elevator 46\"x34\"; crate max 44\"x32\"
```
Also need booth-buddy schedule.

Jordan Ruiz: Panelists: Alyssa (Marketing), Dr. L. Chen (ML Infra), Marco (PartnerX). Lightning talk backup: Priya. Need 2-slide sanitized benchmark summary.

Priya Kaur: I'll do the 10-min demo if picked. Title draft: "Three levers to halve inference spend". Need sanitized metrics + demo script.

Ram Singh: Sanitized metrics for slides:
```
Baseline throughput: 40 tps
Optimized: 93 tps (+2.33x)
Median p95 latency: 90ms -> 70ms
Token cost: $0.011 -> $0.0049 (quantize + batching)
```
I'll create a single-slide PDF for presenters.

Jordan Ruiz: Typeform -> Segment -> SFDC mapping plan:
- typeform.email -> sf_contact.email
- typeform.company -> sf_account.name
- typeform.role -> sf_lead.title
- typeform.interest -> sf_lead.Use_Case__c
- segment.traits.utm_source -> sf_campaign
Slack webhook -> #sales-events for qualified leads. @DevEx can you confirm endpoint?

DevEx: Webhook exists. Share a sample payload.

Jordan Ruiz: Test payload:
```
{
  "email": "test+dc2026@redwood.ai",
  "company": "ExampleCo",
  "role": "ML Platform",
  "interest": "inference-cost",
  "utm_source": "qr_dc2026"
}
```
Tested -> Segment recorded -> SFDC Lead created and assigned. Will post logs.

Sylvia Nguyen: Request: print 500 small QR cards (2.5\"x3.5\") linking to benchmark blog. Copy: "See the numbers: how we cut inference cost 2x. Scan for benchmarks, demo & trial." CTA: "Get the benchmarks". Will wireframe.

Mike Patel: Venue note: curbside lift for heavy crates estimated $220. Approve? @Alyssa

Alyssa Chen: Approve the lift. Add to PO. Include insurance item.

booth-bot: Reminder: swag order cutoff in 5 days per vendor SLA.

Ram Singh: COI uploaded. Extra demo table reserved. Handheld lead scanner ordered.

Jordan Ruiz: Typeform preview (mock): https://typeform.com/to/mock. QR redirect -> https://redwood.ai/datacity/benchmarks?utm_source=qr_dc2026. Will share logs after another test.

Priya Kaur: Drafting breakfast invite and the webinar nurture (Day0: thanks + benchmarks, Day3: case study, Day7: demo CTA).

Alyssa Chen: Action recap:
- Mike: finalize carrier + add lift to PO + booth-buddy schedule
- Sylvia: upload print files + QR card art + submit PO
- Jordan: submit lightning slot/biographies + finalize Typeform mapping + share test logs
- Priya: finalize lightning content + draft webinar nurture
- Ram: finalize AV rig + COI + freight coord
I'll check in in 24 hours. :rocket:

Mike Patel: Posting carrier options by EOD.

Jordan Ruiz: Speaker bios uploaded; submitting lightning tonight.

Priya Kaur: Confirmed for lightning. Drafting the follow-up sequence.

Alyssa Chen: Closing thread unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
